note: Watch order. The first two before you send anything. After that, the video on the step you are on. Do not binge the rest. Lesson films use path under MEDIA.baseUrl (Lightsail CDN), not YouTube.
watchWhen: Week 1: watch the first two, then start the work. Later videos sit on the step they belong to. Open that step, watch, then do the steps.

tracks.title: Watch these two first
tracks.blurb: Week 1, before you send a profile or a site to anyone. LinkedIn so people can find you. A one-page site so they have somewhere to look.

items.title: Stream test · Big Buck Bunny (CC)
items.watchWhen: CDN test clip. Confirm play, scrub, and 360p–4K. Real LinkedIn film replaces this path.

items.title: A one-page site that shows your work
items.watchWhen: Watch this before you pick the repo and put a link online.

tracks.title: How the work runs
tracks.blurb: Still week 1, after the first two. How this board works, how you send work and get notes back, and the simple board we use (to do, doing, done: that is Kanban; a short weekly plan is the useful part of Scrum).

items.title: How this board works
items.watchWhen: Watch once, on day one. A step is done when it has a link.

items.title: Send work, get notes, change it
items.watchWhen: Watch before you send your first thing for review.

items.title: To do, doing, done, and a weekly plan
items.watchWhen: Watch when you start the studio project. Kanban is the board. Scrum is the weekly plan. We use both, simply.

tracks.title: When you start the project
tracks.blurb: Weeks 3–6. Watch the one that matches the step you are on, then do that step. Graph engineering is reading code you did not write. CCVV is the four skills: say it, understand it, choose it, check it.

items.title: Reading code you did not write
items.watchWhen: Watch on the messy-code step, before you change anything. This is graph engineering: follow one request, then name what would break.

items.title: Four skills: say it, understand it, choose it, check it
items.watchWhen: Watch once in week 3. Communication, Comprehension, Vision, Verification. Every drill and every review uses these.

items.title: Build the change, then ask for a review
items.watchWhen: Watch when you start the actual change on the studio repo.
